snippet.title: Styx: Blades of Greed - Pre-Order Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order Styx: Blades of Greed now: https://www.nacongaming.com/en-US/styx-blades-of-greed

A Steam demo of Styx: Blades of Greed is available now!

You can pre-order the game right now and secure exclusive content to be ready for the next Styx's adventure!

Pre-order the standard edition and unlock the Master of Shadow skin, inspired by Styx: Master of Shadows.

You can also pre-order the Quartz Edition (Deluxe). It gives you even more to start your heist in style:
- Additional outfits
- Exclusive dagger skins
- A starter pack with 2 skill points and crafting materials
- 2-day early access to the game when pre-ordered

Sharpen your blades, plan your infiltration, and get ready to steal everything in your path.

Styx: Blades of Greed launches February 19, 2026 on PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S.

Follow Styx on X (Twitter) ► https://x.com/StyxVideoGames

Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290690
Playstation ► https://store.playstation.com/product/EP6665-PPSA28835_00-STYX300000000000
Xbox ► https://www.microsoft.com/p/buy/9NZTKVTDZ2LB
